title: ר' חלפתא דמן הונא

paragraphs: R. Chalafta of Huna; another version has Chaifa. R. Yochanan said to his sons, “Thus your father said”—another version adds “in Rav's name”: Gittin 86b. In that matter in Jerusalem Yevamot, chapter 3, halakhah 9, “R. Chalafta of Hava” is a scribal error.
